Daily from 06:00. Lows over 4 % in 3 days -> 10 % lower (not under 80 %). Below 100 %, highs over 8 % with few lows -> back up, never above 100 %. More than 100 % is only a hint: you decide.

Split meal bolus

Off by default. GIVES INSULIN. Dose = carbs / CR of now, minus the bolus insulin still active. Fast meal: all now. Normal: 60 % now. Slow: 50 % now. The rest is checked every minute from 20 min: given only when the smoothed glucose is 5.5 or more and rising (0.5 in 15 min); never under 4.5 or while falling; minus the SMB given meanwhile; dropped after 90 min (slow 180) with a notice. Every dose goes through the pump queue with all AAPS limits.
The split bolus GIVES INSULIN by itself (the rest of a meal bolus). Use it on a test phone and the bench first, never on the child before that. Turn it on?
